jobs.title: Remote Install Project Manager
jobs.description:
Andersen Corporation Summary

At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live.

Our portfolio of brands — Andersen Windows & Doors, Renewal by Andersen and Fenetres MQ — is crafted to serve customers across the new residential, home improvement and light commercial building sector.

Join our more than 13,000 employees who are inspired every day to deliver exceptional experiences that turn possibility into reality.

Job Description

Renewal by Andersen is looking for a Remote Install Project Manager to join our Southwest Florida team!

This position requires a Tuesday through Saturday work schedule.

The Project Manager will effectively manage window and door replacement projects starting at technical measures and job specifications through the installation process to ensure Homeowner Delight, while focusing efforts to meet and/or exceed budget expectations.

Responsibilities

Accurately measure the dimensions and determine installation processes for windows and doors
Provide installation solutions that match customer expectations, adapts production specifications to the installation requirements, utilizing a thorough knowledge of Renewal Products
Confirms details within the sales contract to assure customer expectations are in alignment with product features and options and installation process
Provides feedback to sales representatives when a job goes on hold, works with reps to resolve questions in a quick and efficient manner.
Determines installation labor duration and installation materials needed to successfully complete the job.
Completes and submits required job files that are complete, correct and timely providing quality hand off to internal customers
Communicate with Installation crew on specifics for the jobs, providing advanced notice of unique factors the crew will need to be aware of with the job.
Approves any additional installation labor required to complete the job
Trouble shoots issues with installation crew on day of installation; this may include onsite support for the job.
Work directly with Homeowners to resolve installation process issues.
Provide support to sales reps with pre-sale site visits to define project scope and ensure the scope of work is reflected in pricing and contract documents.
Supports installation leadership on recruitment of installation sub-contractors

Qualification And Skill Requirements

High school diploma
A minimum of 5 years of work experience in the home improvement or other closely related field.
Previous customer service experience, especially win/win problem solving and conflict resolution skills required.
Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of applicable building codes and construction techniques.
Previous work experience recruiting independent contractors.
Ability to work in a team environment

Pay Range

$69,840.00 - $104,760.00

Culture And Benefits

At Andersen, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, their talent, dedication and passion enables us to be the most trusted window & door company. To support our employees, we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards Package – a thoughtful combination of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to investing in each team member’s wellbeing and success. While specific benefits may vary by position or location, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support your well‑being, growth, and future. Our benefits include:

401 (k) Plan, Employer Fixed Contributions & Company Matching
Profit Sharing*
Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage*
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)*, Health Savings Account (HSA) and Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
Life Insurance
Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
Paid Maternity Leave & Paid Parental Leave*
Career Growth Planning & Nationwide Career Opportunities
For employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement, some benefits may differ or may not be available based on the terms of the agreement.

PROFIT SHARING:
In 2026 Andersen has set a profit-sharing target of $3,600 per eligible employee, prorated as appropriate. Profit Sharing will be paid out in quarterly installments to provide eligible employees with payments throughout the year, with payment amounts tied to quarterly operating profit performance.

EEOC EMPLOYER: Andersen is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, marital status, national origin, citizenship, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Andersen Corporation will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable federal, state and local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, participate in a job interview, or engage in any part of the hiring process, please contact HRCompliance@andersencorp.com.

We look forward to seeing how your unique skills, background and experiences will inspire our team and help us continue to be the leader we are today.

jobs.title: Principal Project Manager (B2B) - Donut Studios
jobs.description:
WHY DONUT STUDIOS?

At New Engen, we help brands grow, not just bigger, but smarter. We’re a digital marketing agency that drives meaningful impact across the entire customer journey by integrating media, creative, analytics, influencer, and retail strategies into performance-driven campaigns.

Donut Studios is our in-house creative studio, purpose-built to craft high-performing, platform-native, and digital content for the world’s most ambitious brands. As a key part of New Engen’s suite of specialized solutions, alongside offerings like the Acorn Creator Suite — Donut Studios helps unlock breakthrough creative that drives results, fast.

We’re a collaborative group of strategists, content creators, copywriters, editors, designers, account strategists, and more who are all in on helping brands, and each other, thrive. We work hard, stay humble, and build with purpose.

What You'll Do

Keep Projects Moving

Manage day-to-day project timelines, task tracking, and creative workflows using Workfront, Asana, and Notion ensuring deliverables stay on schedule from brief through final delivery.

Run an Agile Operating Cadence

AWS operates on an agile model — daily standups and other agile ceremonies are a standing expectation. You'll run or participate in sprint ceremonies, manage backlogs, and adapt scope in short, iterative cycles depending on your workstream (e.g., two-day turnarounds for embedded/quick-turn work, two-week sprints for always-on support).

Drive Clear, Two-Way Communication

Own the cadence of project updates and delivery forecasts. This role requires both strong client-facing communication (representing the engagement professionally to AWS stakeholders, under the New Engen brand) and strong internal communication (keeping creative, strategy, and cross-functional teammates aligned on priorities, timelines, and next steps).

Support Creative & Event Delivery

Coordinate creative assignments across the full project lifecycle. Depending on workstream, this may include coordinating global event delivery across time zones (GMT, EST, APJ), managing tight SLAs and late-breaking content, or supporting on-site production logistics (e.g., re:Invent).

Own Budget & Reporting

Monitor pod budget and monthly burn-rate reporting; track scope and spend through the PO → IDP → campaign → work-order structure, flagging when net-new work requires an amended work order.

Stay One Step Ahead

Maintain accurate project trackers, monitor timelines, identify potential risks early, and proactively communicate issues before they impact delivery. Own escalation handling for your pod.

Collaborate Across Teams

Partner with creatives, strategists, and clients to keep everyone aligned on project status, expectations, deliverables, and priorities across a large, cross-functional team.

Embrace Smarter Ways of Working

Support the implementation of AI-powered workflows, automation, and operational improvements that help teams work more efficiently.

Solve Problems Every Day

Remove day-to-day project roadblocks, escalate larger issues when needed, and help keep momentum across multiple deliverables and deadlines.

Grow Your Craft

Work closely with the Senior/Director PM to strengthen your project management skills, complete AWS-specific onboarding (badging, Workfront training), and continue building your operational expertise.

What You Bring

7+ years of project management or project coordination experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, or fast-paced client services environment.
Agile project management experience required — hands-on familiarity with Scrum/Kanban ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, backlog management) and comfort operating in short, iterative cycles.
Strong client and internal communication skills — able to represent the engagement professionally to enterprise client stakeholders, while also keeping internal cross-functional teams clearly informed and aligned.
Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
Proficiency with Workfront, Asana, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace (or similar tools); willingness to learn client-specific systems.
Comfort with budget tracking/reporting (burn rate, work orders) and managing escalations under pressure.
Ability to coordinate across time zones for global/event-based work, as needed by workstream.
Familiarity with AI-powered tools and a willingness to embrace new technologies.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to identify issues early.
Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred but not required.

Perks & Benefits

Remote or hybrid work environment with flexible hours
Unlimited PTO + company holidays
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability coverage
Life & AD&D insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave & family support
Pet care perks & insurance
Learning & career development programs
Commuter & transit benefits
Exclusive employee discounts

Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000 annually

Compensation for each opportunity is determined based on the applicable labor market, the scope and structure of the role or engagement, and the individual’s qualifications and experience.

New Engen is proud to have offices in Seattle, New York, and Northwest Arkansas, each one anchoring teams that drive creativity, collaboration, and culture. But great work isn’t limited to those zip codes. We also support a distributed team of remote employees across the country, giving people the flexibility to do their best work wherever they are.

We currently hire full-time employees in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin

Let’s Build What’s Next Together — If you’re passionate about media and eager to make a meaningful impact with a team that’s all in, we’d love to hear from you.

Important Notice About Job Openings

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These attempts are often designed to steal your personal information or trick you into paying fees for recruitment or training services.

New Engen does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fees at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process.

All legitimate job openings will be posted directly on our careers page. Communication about these roles will come exclusively from New Engen Recruitment through our ATS, Greenhouse. We will never conduct recruiting outreach through unsolicited text messages or from the @newengen.online domain.

If you have any concerns about the authenticity of any message claiming to be from New Engen, please contact us immediately at peopleteam@newengen.com before taking any further action.

We take your security seriously and are here to support you, ensuring your job search is a safe, positive experience.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Supply Chain Project Manager at Hyper Solutions leads cross-functional supply chain initiatives from concept through execution, ensuring projects related to sourcing, supplier performance, inventory optimization, ERP enhancements, logistics, and operational scalability are delivered on time and aligned with the company’s growth strategy.

This role serves as a critical bridge between Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and external suppliers—driving structure, accountability, and visibility across complex manufacturing and infrastructure programs. The ideal candidate brings strong project leadership, deep supply chain acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset to help build scalable systems that support Hyper’s rapid growth.

Core Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end supply chain projects including supplier onboarding, capacity expansion, inventory strategy, logistics optimization, ERP enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.
Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and budgets.
Drive project governance, status reporting, escalation, and stakeholder communication.
Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management on new supplier introductions, contract implementations, and on-time delivery improvement initiatives.
Coordinate with domestic and international suppliers on production readiness, lead times, and capacity planning.
Serve as project lead for NetSuite-related supply chain initiatives, including workflow enhancements, inventory and demand planning improvements, and KPI standardization.
Align cross-functional execution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, Logistics, and Field Services.
Establish and track performance metrics (OTD, inventory turns, days on hand, supplier performance).

Additional Responsibilities

Support mitigation planning for supply risk, shortages, and quality issues.
Develop SOPs, playbooks, and project templates to improve repeatability and scalability.
Facilitate project reviews, decision forums, and post-implementation retrospectives.
Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned and process standardization.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing project management.
Proven success leading cross-functional projects in fast-growing or complex environments.
Strong understanding of procurement, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and manufacturing or infrastructure supply chains.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred).
Proficiency with project management tools (Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in electrical infrastructure, data center, industrial manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environments.
Familiarity with supplier contracts, MSAs, and performance metrics.
Experience supporting international suppliers and global logistics.
PMP, CPIM, CSCP, or similar certification a plus.

Why Hyper?

At Hyper, you won’t just manage projects, you’ll help build the systems and processes that enable a rapidly scaling organization to deliver mission-critical power and infrastructure solutions. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and suppliers, gaining broad exposure across the full supply chain while playing a visible role in driving execution, efficiency, and operational excellence.

In addition to competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) with company match, Hyper offers clear opportunities for professional growth and development as the company continues to scale.

Location

Onsite in Richmond, VA, or remote depending on candidate location and business needs.

Compensation

The anticipated minimum starting salary range for this role is $105,000 - $135,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications and location. This hire will be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

Hyper Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.

All applications will be used exclusively for selection purposes and handled confidentially by authorized personnel only. Your application may also be considered for other suitable positions within Hyper Solutions, Inc.

Please note that Hyper Solutions is currently unable to offer visa sponsorship, and applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Solar PV Project Manager
jobs.description:
Remote / Home-Based | UK-wide travel

Company Car + Benefits

Permanent | Full-time

Noble Green Energy is growing — and we’re looking for an experienced Solar PV Project Manager to take ownership of the delivery of our commercial and industrial solar projects across the UK.

This is a genuine delivery role. You’ll take an issued design package and turn it into a completed, operational installation — owning the programme, subcontractors, live site delivery and client relationship from mobilisation through to handover.

We have a significantly increasing volume of commercial installations coming through, alongside a growing pipeline of larger 1 MW–20 MWp projects, so this is an opportunity to join a business where your experience will have real impact from day one.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

🔹 Building and owning project programmes and Gantt charts using MS Project, Asta Powerproject, Primavera or similar

🔹 Managing multiple live C&I solar installations simultaneously

🔹 Planning and sequencing works from design handover through procurement, installation, commissioning and handover

🔹 Managing electrical, roofing, scaffolding, steelwork, craneage and specialist subcontractors

🔹 Holding contractors accountable for programme, quality and safety

🔹 Mobilising sites, coordinating trades and managing day-to-day delivery

🔹 Reviewing RAMS, carrying out safety audits and fulfilling relevant CDM 2015 responsibilities

🔹 Inspecting installations against design, specification and BS 7671 requirements

🔹 Managing snagging, commissioning, testing and final handover

🔹 Acting as the main client contact throughout construction

🔹 Chairing progress meetings and providing clear reporting to senior stakeholders

🔹 Managing variations and keeping projects commercially and operationally on track

What We’re Looking For

You’ll need at least 3 years’ hands-on experience managing commercial and industrial solar PV installations
— managing the build and delivery rather than supporting someone else who does.

You Should Also Have

✅ Proven experience creating and managing your own project programmes

✅ Strong subcontractor management experience

✅ SMSTS or SSSTS

✅ Valid CSCS or ECS card

✅ Good understanding of electrical drawings, single line diagrams and BS 7671

✅ Confidence dealing with senior client stakeholders

✅ Experience managing multiple live sites

✅ Strong organisation and documentation skills

✅ Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel nationwide

✅ Existing right to work in the UK — no sponsorship available

Desirable Experience

It would be great if you also have:

18th Edition / C&G 2382
Inspection & Testing / C&G 2391
NEBOSH or IOSH
APM PMQ, PRINCE2 or equivalent
Ground-mount and larger-scale solar projects (1 MW+)
Battery energy storage integrated with PV
MCS experience
DNO process knowledge (G98/G99/G100)
Solar PV O&M experience

Importantly, this is not a design position.

You won't be expected to produce PV designs, use PVsyst/AutoCAD/OpenSolar/Helioscope/PV*SOL, or originate grid connections. Those responsibilities sit with our Technical Manager.

We're looking for someone who is decisive on site, highly organised, technically credible and straightforward with clients and contractors — someone who takes ownership and gets projects delivered properly, safely and on time.

What’s on offer?

Competitive basic salary, depending on experience (£50,000 - £60,000)
Bonus
Company car
25 days’ holiday + bank holidays
Company pension
Perkbox benefits
Remote / home-based working
Nationwide travel with expenses covered

If you're an experienced C&I Solar PV Project Manager looking for a role with genuine responsibility, strong project pipeline and the opportunity to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Senior Biospecimen Project Manager (FSP)

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

As a Senior Project Manager, Laboratory at ICON, you will design and analyse clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.

What You Will Do

You will oversee clinical laboratory operations workstreams, ensuring deliverables meet quality and timeline expectations.

Key Responsibilities Include

Ensure client satisfaction by acting as the Client's main contact in all matters regarding ICON Central Laboratories' (ICL) services, including the setup and day-to-day management of studies.
Attend and represent ICL at Client meetings.
Manage studies in accordance with Good Clinical Practice.
Provide Clients with regular study updates and communicate study progress to Clients and PM Leadership in a responsible and professional manner.
Represent Project Management at internal interdepartmental meetings or interdivisional meetings within ICON.

Your Profile

You will have solid clinical laboratory operations experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as life sciences or healthcare.
Previous experience in project management within a laboratory or clinical research setting.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor and train junior PMs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to represent the company at client meetings and internal meetings.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills to effectively manage study documentation, timelines, and budgets.
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 20%)

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Our EMEA & APAC Creative & Operations team is the engine behind culturally resonant, commercially effective campaigns across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia — reaching millions of customers at the moments that matter most.

As Marketing Project Manager, you'll own the end-to-end workflow that turns briefs into delivered creative across digital design (including our owned channels) and performance marketing for the EMEA & APAC region. This is a delivery-critical, highly collaborative role at the intersection of creative production and performance marketing operations. You'll scope briefs, plan resource, schedule production, and keep design and performance workstreams moving — owning the creative roadmap, flagging risk early, and protecting both quality and timelines. This is a hybrid role (3 days a week onsite) based in our London office and reports to the Senior Creative Project Manager.

You Will:

Own intake and triage of creative briefs across digital design, programmatic, and performance marketing — agreeing scope, timelines, and success criteria before work begins.
Build and maintain workback schedules and campaign roadmaps, sequencing design and performance workstreams to hit launch dates across all active EMEA & APAC markets.
Allocate designers, copywriters, and freelance/agency support against demand; forecast capacity and flag constraints before they become delivery risks.
Track assets end-to-end — brief, design, review, legal approval, localisation, and trafficking — in project management tooling (e.g. ClickUp), confirming specs, CTAs, UTMs, and platform requirements before anything goes live.
Coordinate delivery of performance marketing assets across paid social, paid search, display, and programmatic.
Act as the single point of contact between creative, performance marketing, and regional stakeholders for all in-flight projects, communicating dates, dependencies, and blockers proactively.
Partner with creative leads, designers, and copywriters to translate business requirements into actionable, well-scoped briefs, and with growth marketing to align production with campaign flighting and media plans.
Coordinate with EMEA and APAC stakeholders on local requirements, approvals, and compliance needs.
Manage external agencies and vendors — sharing assets, confirming timelines, and running review cycles — and own the UGC workstream and agency relationship.
Maintain live status trackers, accurate documentation, and version control across all live projects.
Own the test-and-learn agenda: run retrospectives, capture learnings, and make sure they shape future briefs and creative development.
Resolve scheduling conflicts, resourcing gaps, and shifting priorities with structured thinking, escalating when trade-offs need leadership input.
Identify and bring in better workflow tools, templates, and processes that reduce rework — especially AI-assisted ones.

You Have:

3-5+ years proven experience managing marketing production workflows, ideally spanning both digital design and performance marketing.
Strong proficiency with project management tools (ClickUp or similar) and familiarity with creative production processes.
Working knowledge of performance marketing channels (paid social, paid search, display, programmatic, landing pages, ASO) and their creative and technical requirements.
Comfort working across Adobe Creative Suite / Figma files at a production level — specs, exports, versioning — even without design authorship.
Experience working with global or multi-market teams and external agencies.
Exceptional organisation: you run multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders without dropping details.
Reliability and accountability: you own projects fully from intake to delivery and surface blockers early.
A proactive, self-directed approach — you spot risks and opportunities without being asked.
A collaborative style that works across designers, copywriters, performance marketers, and regional stakeholders.
High standards and a strong eye for detail.

Nice to have:

Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum).
Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated, multi-market consumer brand.
Additional European or Asian language skills relevant to EMEA & APAC markets.
Familiarity with AI-assisted creative production or workflow tools.

Our Benefits:

Paid Vacation Days
Health insurance
Commuter benefit
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
Continuing education

Almac Group is a global leader in advancing human health. We provide a range of expert services across the drug development lifecycle to pharmaceutical and biotech companies, supporting them in finding treatments for patients.

Almac Clinical Services plays a critical role in supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deliver life-changing medicines to patients around the world. As part of our Project Management Office (PMO), you will join a team responsible for delivering a wide range of strategic projects across our global Clinical Services network.

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead and manage projects from initial concept through to successful completion. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of our business, coordinating cross-functional teams, engaging with stakeholders across multiple sites, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.

Managing stakeholder expectations and providing regular project updates
Reviewing timelines and deliverables to optimise project performance

Supporting continuous improvement and best practice within the PMO function

Joining Almac means becoming part of a fast-paced, growing organisation within a highly regulated industry. We offer a supportive and collaborative working environment, with excellent opportunities for learning, development and long-term career progression across the Almac Group.

We're looking for an experienced project management professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders. A degree level qualification (or equivalent), or a combination of A-Level qualifications and significant project management experience

Experience using Microsoft Office applications including Project, Excel, Word and PowerPoint

Experience managing third-party suppliers and external resources
Experience communicating with senior leadership and executive stakeholders

Applicants must have eligibility to work in the UK/IE with no restrictions OR possess a valid work permit that will allow you to take up full time employment in the UK/IE.

Further information

Further information on the essential and desirable criteria required for this role can be found in the Job Description attached to this advert.

Please note that this role may require occasional travel to support project delivery across Almac Clinical Services sites.

A competitive salary and benefits package is available, including annual bonus, generous holiday allowance, healthcare reimbursement scheme and the opportunity to contribute to projects that support the advancement of human health.

Apply online and tailor your CV to outline how you meet the role criteria. Please upload your CV in PDF format where possible.

Manage the end-to-end delivery of software development projects, from project initiation to closure.

Allocate resources and manage project teams to ensure project deliverables are met.

Lead project meetings, including kick-off meetings, status meetings, and project reviews.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, QA, and product management, to ensure project success.

Qualifications

3 years of experience managing complex enterprise software product solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong leadership and team management skills.

Knowledge and experience of integration with one or more ERP systems (Wynne, Point of Rental, Fame, etc.).
Ability to multi-task and deliver high-quality results.
Capable of working effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Competence to successfully manage multiple projects concurrently.
Knowledge and understanding of eCommerce and Procurement sites.
Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in story grooming, story writing, and estimation using story points.
Knowledge of EDI PO and EDI Invoice processes.
PMP Certification preferred.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographical location, etc. This role also qualifies for up to 5% of their annual salary in an incentive performance bonus.

SmartEquip, an RB Global company (NYSE: RBA) (TSX: RBA) is a leading, omnichannel marketplace that provides value-added insights, services and transaction solutions for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles worldwide. Through its auction sites in 13 countries and digital platform, RB Global serves customers in more than 170 countries across a variety of asset classes, including automotive, commercial transportation, construction, government surplus, lifting and material handling, energy, mining and agriculture.
The company’s marketplace brands include Ritchie Bros., the world’s largest auctioneer of commercial assets and vehicles offering online bidding, and IAA, a leading global digital marketplace connecting vehicle buyers and sellers. RB Global’s portfolio of brands also includes Rouse Services, which provides a complete end-to-end asset management, data-driven intelligence and performance benchmarking system; SmartEquip, an innovative technology platform that supports customers’ management of the equipment lifecycle and integrates parts procurement with both OEMs and dealers; Xcira, a leader in live simulcast auction technologies; and Veritread, an online marketplace for heavy haul transport.

jobs.title: Program Manager III
jobs.description:
This is a remote position that can be located anywhere in the US.

Position Purpose

Drive strategic healthcare transformation initiatives across health plan operations by identifying opportunities to improve clinical and operational performance, enhance member outcomes and experience, reduce healthcare costs, and support regulatory and contractual requirements.

Lead multiple concurrent initiatives from opportunity identification and business case development through implementation and performance measurement. Partner closely with clinical operations, Medical Economics, Finance, IT, Product, Provider/Network teams, Payment Integrity, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate healthcare data and operational needs into actionable strategies and measurable results.

This role requires an understanding of the healthcare payer environment, including managed care and Medicaid, and the ability to independently lead complex initiatives that span clinical, operational, financial, and technical functions.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve healthcare quality, clinical and operational efficiency, member outcomes, service levels, regulatory compliance, and medical cost performance.
Lead strategic initiatives across health plan functions, including areas such as Utilization Management, Care Management, Behavioral Health, LTSS, Clinical Operations, and other payer operations.
Partner with Medical Economics, Finance, Analytics, and business leaders to understand healthcare utilization and cost trends, identify key drivers and addressable opportunities, develop business cases, and establish appropriate performance measures.
Interpret healthcare data and operational findings to help translate identified opportunities into actionable strategies, project plans, and measurable interventions.
Develop strategies to realize improvement and cost-saving opportunities and facilitate organizational prioritization, leadership alignment, and resource allocation.
Manage multiple complex projects and initiatives through the full project lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, business case development, planning, implementation, measurement, and transition to operational ownership.
Establish project objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, decision points, and performance measures and maintain appropriate project governance and documentation.
Lead cross-functional workgroups involving clinical, operational, financial, analytical, technical, and executive stakeholders to drive decisions and deliver defined outcomes.
Partner with IT, Product, and operational teams to translate business and clinical requirements into technology-enabled solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.
Monitor initiative performance following implementation, partnering with business owners and Medical Economics/Analytics to evaluate outcomes, validate realized impact, and identify opportunities for continued improvement.
Provide clear and concise communication of project status, risks, financial opportunities, decisions, and performance to senior and executive leadership through presentations, dashboards, and executive summaries.
Navigate competing priorities and negotiate with stakeholders to secure resources, resolve issues, mitigate risks, and maintain progress toward strategic objectives.
Maintain working knowledge of managed care operations, healthcare industry trends, regulatory requirements, and Medicaid program considerations relevant to assigned initiatives.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Master’s degree preferred.
5+ years project implementation, product or program management experience.
Experience within a healthcare payer or managed care organization strongly preferred, with knowledge of Medicaid and/or other government-sponsored health programs preferred.
Demonstrated understanding of healthcare payer operations and the relationship between clinical operations, healthcare utilization, medical cost, quality, regulatory requirements, and financial performance preferred.
Experience partnering with Medical Economics, healthcare analytics, Finance, or similar functions to evaluate utilization and cost trends, develop business cases, establish performance measures, and assess initiative outcomes preferred.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional healthcare initiatives involving clinical, operational, financial, analytical, and/or technology stakeholders preferred.
Strong executive communication, facilitation, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to independently drive initiatives from an identified opportunity through implementation and measurement preferred.
Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) and/or healthcare-related credentials preferred but not required.

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.
You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. jobs.description:
About Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of GPU clusters and other critical IT infrastructure components that power next-generation AI workloads. In this high-impact role, you’ll coordinate engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams to deliver GPU clusters and critical IT infrastructure at hyperscale. You’ll work closely with infrastructure leadership to define strategy, manage risk, and ensure on-time, high-quality launches. You’ll play a key role in scaling our global infrastructure footprint across the United States market.

Travel: This position may require on-site presence at data centers during key deployment phases.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Lead end-to-end delivery of new data center programs, from design through handover to operations.
Define and manage scope, schedule, and risks, maintaining focus on critical paths and proactive issue resolution.
Translate business and technical requirements into actionable project plans and measurable deliverables.
Oversee vendor and contractor execution, ensuring quality, budget, and schedule.
Provide structured program reporting, including dashboards, documentation, and executive updates.

Technical Scope & Expectations

This role requires hands-on experience with physical infrastructure delivery, not only software or coordination-based program management.

You should be comfortable working across multiple layers of infrastructure, including:

Data center environments: understanding of IT infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, and networking dependencies before hardware installation);
Compute infrastructure: experience with large-scale server deployments (GPU-based systems are a strong plus);
Networking: familiarity with high-bandwidth fabrics (e.g., InfiniBand or equivalent), cabling, and integration dependencies;
Commissioning & bring-up: exposure to system validation, burn-in testing, and readiness criteria before handover to operations.

You are not expected to be an engineer, but you should be able to:

Engage in technical discussions confidently.
Identify risks related to infrastructure readiness and sequencing.
Challenge assumptions and drive resolution across engineering teams.

We Expect You To Have

7+ years of experience in technical program or project management, with direct involvement in large-scale IT infrastructure deployments.
Solid technical background in relevant domains, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and challenge solutions where needed.
Proven ability to stay focused on critical paths and drive results in fast-paced, changing environments.
Communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate complex topics clearly.
Leadership by influence and example in cross-functional or matrixed teams.
Proficient with modern project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Asana, hybrid Agile/Waterfall).

It Will Be An Added Bonus If You Have

Understanding of construction projects structure and key risk factors in facility build-outs.
Knowledge of HPC
Experience in business processes design or automation tools development.
PMP, PRINCE2, or similar industry certifications.

Key Employee Benefits In The US

Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.

Compensation

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $115K to $275K OTE, which includes base salary and performance bonus. Equity in the form of RSUs may be available at certain salary grades.

Join Nebius Today!

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

What's It Like To Work At Nebius

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Position Summary

PennEngineering is a leader in the manufacturing of specialty fasteners and is committed to providing quality, value-added products and services. The Program Manager – Automotive, North America is responsible for planning, overseeing and leading automotive fastener programs from customer RFQ through Start of Production and post-launch handover. This position is a primary role within PEM North America and requires a multi-skilled, highly capable person who will interact with a range of stakeholders, internal departments and external customers, and will manage several programs simultaneously.

The Program Manager is responsible for creating and managing the plan that will meet the objectives of each program while adhering to an agreed budget and timeline. The role is the single point of accountability for assigned programs and operates against the Master Automotive Fastener Launch Timeline, a fourteen-gate structure (G0 through G13) aligned to APQP and customer-specific requirements. Duties include defining program scope, securing the necessary resources, anticipating time and financial requirements, chairing gate reviews, communicating to all stakeholders and controlling program documentation.

Join us as we build the future in Manufacturing and Engineering!

PTO, holiday pay, 401K, tuition reimbursement
Medical, Dental and vision insurance
Parental Leave
Company provided technology including Laptop, necessary monitors and hardware for office and home environments, iPhone, etc.
Employee Centric Culture

Develop plans that will meet the objectives of each program
Manage relationships with all internal departments, stakeholders, external parties and customers
Manage program progress, adjusting work when required to ensure programs meet their deadlines
Monitor and report on program progress. Measure and analyze programs to ensure they are developing as planned
Coordinate internal program activities and resources across Commercial, Engineering, Manufacturing, Tooling, Quality, Supply Chain and Logistics
Assemble and lead cross-functional program teams, holding functional owners accountable for the deliverables and exit criteria assigned to them at each gate
Maintain the master launch timeline for each assigned program, expressed in weeks relative to SOP, and keep it aligned to customer build and PPAP dates
Chair formal gate reviews and exercise the authority to approve, conditionally approve or hold a gate based on documented exit criteria
Escalate gate holds, schedule risk and resource conflicts promptly and at the appropriate level
Conduct program reviews and create detailed and summary program reports
Oversee and ensure all program documentation is up to date and archived for future reference, providing a history that can be revisited when planning similar programs, including quote assumptions, timing plans, gate records and PPAP files
Communicate clearly and regularly on program updates and progress with all stakeholders, external parties and customers
Understand program risks and design contingency plans, so each program continues moving forward even when obstructions occur; own and maintain the program risk register
Implement, optimize and improve program management procedures, including the launch gate process itself
Help secure new business and growth opportunities by delivering new parts on time and within budget
Initiate new projects that will improve and optimize in-house processes

Location

Danboro, PA

Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management or similar field / equivalent tangible experience
Minimum five years of experience in a production, engineering or project management role, including at least three years managing automotive programs at a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier
Demonstrated experience carrying a minimum of two programs from RFQ through Start of Production

Commercial awareness and customer focus
Quality and efficiency focused
Experience of dealing with customers, including customer-facing program reviews and on-site build support

Formal AIAG or VDA core tools training
Experience across multiple OEM/Tier customer requirement sets
Experience with BEV, HEV and ICE fastener applications

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Release Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

As a Staff Technical Program Manager (Release Management), you will report to the Manager of Release Management and join our Software Product-Design team. This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role that balances strategic release architecture and automation with hands-on, day-to-day release train execution. We are hiring for this role to help drive scale and automation in our release operations for predictive prevention, establishing robust automated release gating as our commercial driverless fleet scales from a dozen vehicles to thousands. This is a high-impact opportunity for a force multiplier who thrives on combining hands-on tactical execution with long-term operational scale. You are highly motivated to remove manual friction, manage release operations, and automate software release and deployment frameworks in a safety-critical, high-velocity environment.

In this role you will

Lead Day-to-Day Release Operations & Cadence: Own and execute the end-to-end release cycle, including orchestrating regular release train schedules, managing branch cut-offs, running daily release/build triage, and coordinating hotfix deployments across software and vehicle platforms.
Cross-Functional Coordination & Release Communication: Serve as the primary operational hub for release readiness, driving daily alignment across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams while maintaining transparent release communications and dashboards.
Drive Predictive Prevention and Release Automation: Shift release operations toward predictive prevention by identifying and eliminating manual friction points, automating release workflows, and utilizing AI/ML tools for triage classification and anomaly detection.
Establish Data-Driven Release Gating: Help architect and maintain automated "Release Gates" that auto-assemble compliance evidence using structured data (Single Source of Truth), ensuring rigorous quality and safety standards before release promotion.
Manage High-Scale Branching & Change Control: Govern and orchestrate concurrent release branches across diverse customers, hardware configurations, and Operational Design Domains (ODDs), maintaining absolute branching hygiene and change control.
Ensure Safety-First Rigor and Auditable Compliance: Treat release documentation and launch reports with software-grade discipline—ensuring version control, complete auditability, and safety compliance without introducing operational bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications

7+ Years of Hands-On Release Experience: Technical program management, release engineering, or systems engineering background with direct, day-to-day release train execution and managing software-hardware integrations in complex environments.
Safety-Critical Domain Expertise: Experience working under strict safety-regulated standards (such as ISO 26262, DO-178C, or ISO 13485) within automotive, aerospace, medical or robotics, with strong configuration management, baseline, and change control practices.
Tactical Build & CI/CD Execution: Practical, hands-on technical experience with CI/CD build automation tools (e.g., Buildkite, GitHub Actions) and monorepo build systems (e.g., Bazel) to troubleshoot and execute daily release operations at scale.
Complex Branching & Daily Triage: Proven track record of orchestrating concurrent release branches, running hands-on daily build/release triage, and executing hotfix deployments across diverse teams and hardware platforms.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance: Collaborative track record of partnering across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams to establish transparent governance, shared release visibility, and cross-team trust.
Customer & Team Support Mindset: Strong team player willing to support internal operations, external partners, and high-priority releases with occasional evening or weekend coverage as needed.
Travel Requirement: Ability to travel to engineering centers in Mountain View, CA, Terminal Operations in Texas or Pittsburgh, PA as business needs arise.

Desirable Qualifications

AV & Robotics Background: Direct, hands-on experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, machine learning systems, or complex cyber-physical environments.
AI-Leveraged Release Operations: Practical experience applying ML/AI tooling to day-to-day release operations, such as automated test-failure classification, triage automation, or pipeline anomaly detection.
Automation-First & Collaborative Mindset: Passion for building self-service release tooling and reducing operational friction while fostering seamless cross-functional alignment and developer enablement.
Cloud & SaaS Infrastructure: Practical familiarity with cloud environments (AWS) and progressive deployment methodologies (feature flagging, progressive delivery, service dependency ordering).
Proactive Execution & Planning: Proven capability to manage day-to-day edge cases and unknown release risks by establishing team-wide visibility and proactive build health tracking.

For roles based in San Francisco, CA and Mountain View, CA: The salary range for this position is $181,000 - $290,000 per year.

For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA: The salary range for this position is $163,000 - $261,000 per year.

Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Description

The Global Services NPDI Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) initiatives that enable the successful launch, service readiness, and global deployment of Vertiv products and service offerings.

This role partners with Global Services, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and regional service organizations to ensure that service requirements are incorporated into product development, design transfer, and launch activities. The Project Manager provides end-to-end project leadership, governance, and execution oversight across Hardware + Services NPDI and Service-Only NPDI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Global Services NPDI Project Leadership
Lead assigned Hardware + Services NPDI and Service-Only NPDI projects from intake through launch and service readiness.
Establish project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across Global Services, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and regional organizations.
Ensure projects align with business priorities, service strategy, and global deployment requirements.
Manage multiple concurrent projects across Vertiv’s business units and product portfolios.
Drive project execution and accountability across geographically distributed teams.
NPDI Governance and Stage-Gate Management
Lead Global Services participation in NPDI governance and stage-gate activities.
Ensure service requirements, risks, dependencies, and readiness activities are identified and addressed throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate project reviews, status updates, and gate readiness assessments.
Track required deliverables and ensure appropriate Global Services assessments are completed.
Partner with BU PMO leads and Product Managers to align project priorities, ownership, and governance expectations.
Escalate risks, issues, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
Service Readiness and Launch Execution
Develop and manage service readiness plans for new products, technologies, and service offerings.
Coordinate readiness activities involving technical documentation, service procedures, training, tools, spare parts, systems, and regional capabilities.
Partner with NPDI Engineers and regional service teams to identify and close readiness gaps.
Ensure service deliverables are aligned with product launch and deployment timelines.
Support design transfer, product introduction, and global service implementation initiatives.
Establish launch readiness criteria and monitor progress through implementation and stabilization.
Portfolio and Resource Management
Support the evaluation and prioritization of new NPDI project intake across the four business units.
Coordinate with BU PMO leads to assess project scope, service involvement, resource requirements, and timing.
Maintain accurate project status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and resource information.
Identify capacity constraints and coordinate resource planning with Global Services leadership.
Support portfolio reporting and provide visibility into project health, progress, and emerging risks.
Contribute to continuous improvement of Global Services PMO processes, standards, and operating models.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Serve as the primary Global Services project contact for assigned NPDI initiatives.
Build strong working relationships with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, BU PMOs, and regional service leadership.
Facilitate alignment across global and regional stakeholders with competing priorities.
Ensure project decisions, actions, and dependencies are clearly communicated.
Promote consistency in service readiness and project execution across regions.
Support the development of global standards, playbooks, and repeatable implementation processes.
Digital Service and Technology Initiatives
Lead or support projects involving digital service capabilities, connected products, field technologies, and service transformation.
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving digital workflows, AI-enabled service tools, predictive maintenance, and connected service solutions.
Ensure technology initiatives address operational requirements and deliver measurable business value.
Partner with technical teams to manage implementation milestones, dependencies, and deployment readiness.
Support the integration of new technologies into global service operations.
Risk Management and Continuous Improvement
Maintain project risk, issue, action, and dependency registers.
Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, operational, and service readiness risks.
Develop mitigation plans and coordinate timely resolution of project issues.
Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into future NPDI initiatives.
Drive improvements in project governance, execution discipline, and launch effectiveness.
Provide leadership with clear recommendations and escalation paths when project performance is at risk.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in project management, program management, operations, engineering, product development, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
Experience with new product introduction, product development, service operations, or technology implementation.
Strong project planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with geographically distributed teams and multiple organizational functions.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment.
Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
Ability to analyze complex problems, establish priorities, and drive actionable outcomes.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in critical infrastructure, data centers, power systems, thermal management, cooling technologies, or related industries.
Experience with NPDI, stage-gate governance, design transfer, or product lifecycle management.
Experience supporting global service organizations or regional capability development.
PMP certification or equivalent project management experience.
Lean Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience.
Experience managing digital transformation, field technology, or service technology projects.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Power BI, or similar project management tools.
Experience developing project governance frameworks, operating models, or PMO standards.

Core Competencies

Project Leadership: Ability to lead complex initiatives from planning through execution and launch.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect project activities to business priorities and global service strategy.
Execution Excellence: Strong ownership of timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and results.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to align cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
Risk Management: Ability to anticipate challenges and develop effective mitigation strategies.
Global Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across regions, cultures, and business units.
Communication: Ability to communicate project status, risks, and decisions clearly to technical and executive audiences.
Continuous Improvement: Commitment to improving project execution, governance, and service readiness.

Travel

Up to 25% travel, including domestic and international travel, based on project and business requirements.

Position Impact

This role ensures that Vertiv’s products, technologies, and service offerings are effectively integrated into global service operations. Through disciplined project execution, cross-functional alignment, and proactive risk management, the Global Services NPDI Project Manager helps reduce launch risk, improve service readiness, and accelerate the successful deployment of innovative solutions to customers worldwide.

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:
Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

High-Performance Culture
Customer Focus
Operational Excellence
Innovation
Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

Own it
Act with urgency
Foster a customer-first mindset
Think big and execute
Lead by example
Drive continuous improvement
Learn and seek out development
Promote transparent & open communication

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Location:

Role Summary:

We are seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead complex, cross-portfolio technology initiatives within Global Product Technology, with a strong focus on Merch Planning, Forecasting, Sizing, and Allocation systems.
This role operates at the intersection of business and technology, owning delivery across multiple interdependent programs. The Staff TPM is responsible for driving end-to-end outcomes, shaping technical and business decisions, and ensuring planning and allocation capabilities deliver measurable business impact.
This role requires deep understanding of retail planning lifecycles, inventory flow, and allocation strategies, combined with the ability to orchestrate complex technology delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Portfolio Ownership & Program Leadership

Own end-to-end delivery outcomes across multiple programs spanning Merch Planning, Sizing, Forecasting, Allocation, and Inventory Optimization
Drive alignment across Flowstate initiatives that support:

Forecast-driven size curves
In-season reforecasting
Allocation and transfer optimization
Ensure execution aligns to GTM gates, buy cycles, and merchandising decision timelines

Deeply understand and incorporate:

Pre-season planning (assortment planning, size curves, buy quantities)
In-season management (reforecasting, transfers, sell-through optimization)
Allocation strategies across DCs and stores
Evaluate tradeoffs between:

Forecast accuracy vs responsiveness
Inventory optimization vs service levels
Automation vs planner control
Ensure technology solutions directly improve:

Forecast accuracy
Inventory productivity
Allocation efficiency
Time-to-decision for planners

3. Technical & Strategic Decision Leadership

Drive cross-system decision-making (architecture, sequencing, data flows, integration with planning tools like Anaplan, Snowflake, etc.)
Lead decision frameworks (options, tradeoffs, recommendations) for business and technology leadership
Ensure solutions reflect end-to-end planning workflows, not isolated system improvements
Act as a technical and business translator between Planning, Product, and Engineering

4. Release Governance & Delivery Management

Own and evolve release governance and readiness processes across planning and allocation systems
Ensure releases align to critical business windows (GTM, buys, peak seasons)
Drive proactive coordination of:

Data dependencies (forecast inputs, inventory signals)
Cross-system releases impacting planners
Prevent business disruption through tight release discipline and validation rigor

5. Delivery Excellence & Operating Model Design

Design and scale delivery operating models for planning systems across multiple teams
Standardize execution practices across:

Backlog readiness tied to business outcomes
Planning feature prioritization
Cross-team coordination
Lead initiatives to improve:

Delivery predictability
Feature adoption by business users
Quality of outputs used by planners

6. Cross-Functional Orchestration & Dependency Management

Act as the single-threaded owner connecting Merch Planning, Allocation, Engineering, Data, and Product teams
Manage dependencies across:

Forecasting engines
Sizing logic
Allocation and transfer systems
Surface and resolve risks tied to data quality, model outputs, and downstream planning impacts

7. Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership

Lead response to production issues impacting planning or allocation outcomes (forecast errors, allocation mismatches, data delays)
Drive root cause analysis with both technical and business context
Ensure continuous improvements in:

SLA adherence
Data accuracy and reliability
Planning system stability

8. Executive Influence & Stakeholder Leadership

Deliver executive-ready insights linking technology delivery to business outcomes (inventory, forecast accuracy, allocation effectiveness)
Influence prioritization decisions based on business value, not just delivery feasibility
Partner with senior leaders across:

Merch Planning
Allocation
Product
Engineering

9. Scalable Mechanisms & Organizational Impact

Build scalable mechanisms tailored to planning and allocation domains:
Forecast validation frameworks
Allocation readiness checklists
Dependency maps across data → models → planning tools
Enable teams to operate with clarity, accountability, and business alignment
Coach PMs/TPMs on connecting delivery execution to merchandising outcomes

Required Qualifications

8–12+ years in Technical Program Management or Program Management
Proven experience owning portfolio-level programs across planning, supply chain, or retail technology domains
Strong understanding of:

Merch Planning and Allocation processes
Forecasting and inventory optimization concepts
Cross-functional delivery in data-driven systems
Demonstrated ability to influence both technical and business leadership decisions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Anaplan, planning systems, or allocation engines
Exposure to AI/ML-based forecasting or optimization models
Experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) and end-to-end data pipelines
Background in retail, apparel, or omnichannel inventory environments

Bachelor’s or Master’s of engineering, or related fields.

Headquartered in Tokyo and with a 400-year history, SMBC Group offers a diverse range of financial services, including banking, leasing, securities, credit cards, and consumer finance. The Group has more than 130 offices and 80,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries. Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (SMFG) is the holding company of SMBC Group, which is one of the three largest banking groups in Japan. SMFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York (NYSE: SMFG) stock exchanges.

In the Americas, SMBC Group has a presence in the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. Backed by the capital strength of SMBC Group and the value of its relationships in Asia, the Group offers a range of commercial and investment banking services to its corporate, institutional, and municipal clients. It connects a diverse client base to local markets and the organization’s extensive global network. The Group’s operating companies in the Americas include Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. (SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

Role Overview

We are seeking a CCAR Finance Program Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of the bank’s Finance stress testing platform, covering finance model execution, capital and balance sheet aggregation, and FR Y-14 regulatory reporting.

This role will drive the implementation and integration of key components of the CCAR finance architecture, including the Finance Model Execution Platform (MEP), enterprise aggregation engine, and regulatory reporting platforms (e.g., Axiom). The program manager will coordinate across Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Technology teams to ensure timely delivery, regulatory compliance, and alignment with enterprise stress testing requirements.

The ideal candidate will combine strong program management experience with deep understanding of CCAR, finance stress testing, and regulatory reporting frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership

Lead the end-to-end CCAR Finance program spanning model execution, aggregation, and regulatory reporting.
Manage delivery across multiple workstreams including Finance MEP, balance sheet and PPNR projections, aggregation, and FR Y-14 reporting.
Define program roadmap, milestones, and delivery plans aligned with regulatory timelines.
Coordinate across Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Technology stakeholders.

Model Execution Platform (MEP)

Oversee implementation of the Finance Model Execution Platform supporting execution of:
Balance sheet projection models
PPNR models
RWA and capital models
Tax and capital action models
Ensure integration with scenario management, data ingestion pipelines, and aggregation layers.

Aggregation

Lead the design and delivery of the CCAR aggregation framework to consolidate outputs from finance and risk models.
Ensure consistency across model outputs and alignment with enterprise stress testing assumptions.
Implement controls for data reconciliation, adjustments, overlays, and audit traceability.

Regulatory Reporting

Manage implementation and integration of FR Y-14 reporting processes including Axiom or similar regulatory platforms.
Ensure automated data feeds from aggregation to reporting templates.
Establish reconciliation controls between aggregation outputs, general ledger, and regulatory reports.

Governance and Regulatory Engagement

Establish program governance, delivery tracking, and issue management processes.
Coordinate with Model Risk Management, Internal Audit, and Regulatory Affairs.
Support regulatory submissions and examinations related to CCAR.

Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary liaison between Finance, Risk, Technology, and external vendors.
Drive alignment across cross-functional teams delivering the CCAR platform.
Provide regular updates to senior finance and technology leadership.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in finance technology, regulatory reporting, or stress testing programs.
Strong knowledge of CCAR / DFAST regulatory frameworks and FR Y-14 reporting requirements.
Experience implementing finance model platforms, aggregation engines, or regulatory reporting systems.
Proven experience managing large cross-functional regulatory programs.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Axiom regulatory reporting platform.
Experience building or managing model execution platforms for finance or risk models.
Familiarity with balance sheet forecasting, PPNR modeling, RWA calculations, and capital planning.
Experience working with cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks) and modern data architectures.
Prior experience working with regulators or regulatory remediation programs.

The company has developed products ranging from chip-level, application-specific integrated circuits (ASIC) to complete, turnkey radar and communication systems. TSC has established a state-of-the-art hardware capability that is well respected by customers in Government and industry. TSC also provides full spectrum systems engineering support including theoretical analysis, requirements generation, interface control, and test planning/execution/data analysis.

This position will be responsible for managing mid-level programs or serving as a deputy program manager on complex programs. This includes tasks that involve design and development of RF, analog, high speed digital, embedded software and firmware efforts. It is expected that the candidate will take ownership to develop and grow relationships with Government program offices, as well as public sector customers. As a Program Manager, you will have ultimate responsibility for overall program execution. Through successful program execution, the candidate will also bring in new business by positioning TSC to be the preferred partner for new programs with existing customers. The successful candidate will also support business development efforts associated with existing as well as new potential customers in the following areas: RF seekers, sensors, target detection devices, electronic warfare systems, and datalinks.

Work closely with the program staff to ensure that schedules are maintained to meet customer objectives and milestones.

Cross functional leadership to ensure designs achieve customer requirements, delivery dates, and milestone objectives.

Support hardware demonstrations, technical discussions, and Q&A with customers.
Capture management of new opportunities with existing customers.
Support business development efforts to expand into new markets/customers.
Track new and upcoming programs of potential customers, fostering relationships, and positioning TSC to be the preferred solution provider.
Assist in the creation of large proposals.
