All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About The Role

This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Expansion Sales organization. You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, multi-team sales organization more productive — spanning our Platform Sales, Expansion AM, and New Expansion Advisor teams. You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers.

You'll help grow revenue from Gusto's existing customer base through upsells and cross-sells. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto expands its relationship with the small businesses it already serves.

About The Team

The Expansion Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support three dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems.

Our work spans pacing and pipeline forecasting, quotas, trigger and backlog management, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, rules of engagement, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping our reps operate efficiently and confidently across a multi-product, multi-team motion.

Here's What You'll Do Day-to-day

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting

Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track pacing, funnel metrics, trigger and backlog health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear.
Own the weekly forecast, CFQ closed-won ARR pacing, and probability-weighted pipeline forecast, feeding the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Weekly Forecast Review (WFR) cadence for sales and executive leadership.
Partner with Finance and Analytics to produce operational reporting and revenue insights across dials, connects, lead passes, self-generated opportunities, and book coverage.
Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on.

Drive AI Strategy for Sales

Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as process automation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process.
Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness.
Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement

Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience.
Evaluate Rules of Engagement (ROE) requests and comp exception asks, applying clear rules and precedent to produce fair, consistent, and binding rulings.
Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows.

Operational Support & Problem-Solving

Provide day-to-day support to Expansion Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations.
Own account and territory administration as the business evolves: assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin (ChiliPiper) automation.
Support onboarding and offboarding for new hires and departing reps, including roster updates, router mapping, and leave-of-absence (LOA) processing.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes — including closed-won opportunities that didn't sync and ARR discrepancies.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication

Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress.
Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements.
Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems.

Here's What We're Looking For

5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use.
Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets.
Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs.
Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors.
A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions.
Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability.
A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting an expansion, upsell, or cross-sell motion into an existing customer base, rather than net-new acquisition.
Experience in payroll, HR tech, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.
Experience supporting a multi-product sales org spanning distinct offerings (e.g., tax credits, contractor payments, health insurance, workers' comp, or EOR).
Experience designing or implementing automations, AI workflows, or similar tooling.
A track record of building cross-functional relationships across Sales, BizTech, and Analytics.
Experience building systems to support new or evolving sales motions, with comfort in fast iteration and testing in live sales environments.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $104,490 to $128,000 for Denver. $126,530 to $155,000 for San Francisco & New York. $97,960 to $120,000 for Phoenix. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days
per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Budget & Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Contingent Worker to support vendor budget and commercial operations. This role is crucial in supporting the day-to-day financial management of vendor engagements ensuring budget accuracy, timely purchase order setup, reliable tracking of vendor deliverables, and clean invoice and accrual treatment. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a strong understanding of foundational financial processes, sound judgment on accounting treatment, and a commitment to meticulous record-keeping across a growing portfolio of vendor agreements. We expect this person to actively use AI tooling in their daily work and to treat the operational processes they inherit as candidates for improvement identifying manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps and partnering with the team to automate them rather than simply absorbing the volume.

Key Responsibilities

This role will be responsible for executing key tasks related to vendor budget and commercial operations, including but not limited to:
End-to-end ownership of initiating, processing, tracking, and maintenance of purchase orders in the ERP system, structured to match each agreement's payment shape (upfront, milestone, or per-delivery)
Monitoring PO funding status and proactively following up on outstanding invoices and related exceptions, initiating top-ups before shortfalls block vendor payment
Maintaining the running view of the approved budget envelope approved, committed, executed, and remaining and flagging when the pipeline approaches the ceiling
Validating pricing on incoming vendor deals against the approved rate card taxonomy and escalating off-taxonomy pricing for sign-off
Serving as day-to-day operational contact for vendors on delivery reporting, PO references, invoice format, service periods, and required reporting data
Owning the delivery tracking log capturing vendor, scope, delivery date, volume, and supporting detail for every reported delivery
Driving deliveries through the review and acceptance workflow, chasing pending items and preventing backlog accumulation, and confirming acceptance before invoices are submitted for payment
Validation of invoices against contract terms and approved parameters, ensuring accuracy of scope, volume delivered, rates charged, service period, and purchase order billed
Route invoices for internal approvals and ensure timely processing for payment
Reconciling and resolving discrepancies between invoices and delivery records by coordinating with vendors and internal teams, including handling credit memos and adjustment lines
Owning the monthly accrual position for vendor spend recognizing delivered-but-uninvoiced work, applying the correct accrual input type, and reconciling accrued vs. invoiced vs. paid
Supporting quarterly forecast inputs for vendor spend, including timing of upfront versus delivery-linked payments
Support the preparation of documentation and reports required for month-end close processes
Tracking contract renewal and expiry dates and surfacing them ahead of decision deadlines
Liaising with S2P, FP&A, Accounting, Sourcing, and Legal to ensure PO accuracy, alignment with approved budgets, and correct accounting treatment
Maintain organized and accessible financial records and process documentation
Assist with ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests from the finance and program teams
Use approved AI and automation tooling to accelerate routine work reconciliation, data extraction from vendor submissions and invoices, summarization, and drafting vendor correspondence while retaining human review and accountability for any number or commitment that leaves the team
Proactively identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps in the operational workflow and propose automation or process redesign opportunities, with a clear view of the time saved and the risk reduced
Partner with the workforce planning and program teams to scope and test automations end to end, and support migration of manual trackers into supported systems as tooling matures
Document processes clearly enough that they can be automated or handed over, and maintain that documentation as workflows change
Ensure adherence to internal financial controls and company policies

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of experience in a finance, accounting, procurement, or vendor operations role with a focus on transactional processing
Demonstrated working knowledge of accruals able to explain and apply the difference between accrued, invoiced, and paid, and build a defensible month-end position where delivery and invoicing are out of sync
Solid understanding of OpEx versus CapEx treatment able to reason about how a given engagement should be classified, what drives capitalization versus expensing, and when to escalate to Accounting rather than deciding alone
Strong cashflow literacy understands the timing gap between contract execution, upfront payment, delivery, acceptance, invoice, and cash out, and how PO structure and payment terms drive it
Proficiency with financial management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and MS Office Suite / Suite (particularly advanced Excel/Sheets skills)
Strong understanding of fundamental accounting principles (AP/AR, general ledger) and financial workflows (PO-to-Pay)
Comfortable working with large datasets and operating in ambiguous environments
Excellent organizational skills and a high degree of attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders, including holding a firm line on data quality and approval gates
Works with a sense of urgency for critical business requests
Customer service oriented person, focused on quality communication with a bias for action
Demonstrated use of AI tooling in a finance or operations context, with sound judgment about where AI output can be trusted and where it must be verified particularly for financial figures, vendor-facing communication, and anything entering a system of record
Track record of identifying inefficiencies in an existing process and driving a concrete improvement, with evidence of the impact
Comfortable working in spreadsheets and workflow tools at a level beyond basic data entry building repeatable reconciliations, validations, and checks rather than re-performing them manually each cycle

Preferred

Experience working in a fast-paced corporate or technology environment
Experience using Anaplan, AppSheet, Oracle, Airtable
Past experience in managing procurement and finance operations for a specific line of business
Comfort working alongside technical or research stakeholders who act as delivery reviewers
Hands-on experience building lightweight automations scripting, low-code or workflow automation platforms, or AI-assisted workflows to replace manual operational steps
Experience contributing to an automation or process-transformation initiative in a finance, procurement, or vendor operations function

Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world.  Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organisation which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving our strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to hire a Marketing Data Analyst to strengthen our MCBD function.

The Opportunity

This role is within the evolving global business development team. You will be working with business development personnel across the firm, including those responsible for the development of client systems and those running business development programmes such as the client programme, the contractor programme and initiatives identified by the Business and Markets Executive / Business Growth and Client Systems leadership. The winning of work and associated activities are key to the success of Arup, more than ever before. This is an opportunity to be part of the team enabling firm growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and assist in the development of all forms of Power BI reporting utilizing CRM, finance and other data for use by the marketing, communications, business development and Business and Markets communities across Arup.
Work with leadership, MCBD and other members of the Client Systems team to define requirements for reporting, to sketch out possible solutions, and to elicit feedback once reporting has been created.
Support the coordination of the Marketing Data Warehouse. Work with our digital marketing experts on our data warehouse that stores data from our digital marketing platform, Marketo, and its evolution to encompass website and social media data. Its aim is to give a complete picture of the operation of our digital marketing channels.
Bring your expertise in reporting to support the development of CRM and other tools so that our data is best configured to produce the reporting we need.
Explore the use of AI to support development of reporting solutions as well as generate insights into our business growth department.
Collaborate with the wider ARUP’s analytics community in predictive modeling and statistical analysis projects that would help surface insights around improving our work-winning processes.

Is this role right for me?

Requirements

Experience in the use of Power BI plus high-level Excel skills.  Desire to grow these skills. Potential interest in languages such as Python and tools such as Databricks and SQL querying.
Experience working with CRM and/or finance data. Knowledge of how to clean data prior to processing.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to think laterally to suggest potential solutions.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.

Qualifications And Accreditations

Degree, postgraduate qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Knowledge Management or a related field.

Knowledge And Experience

Experience in data management, knowledge management and analytics.
Knowledge of client systems and software development.
Proficiency in marketing and communications related technologies, and knowledge of marketing data including bidding and clients data.
Experience in building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of current trends in AI, data information, machine learning and data quality is a plus.

Skills And Attributes

Skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.
Communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Able to build collaborative and inclusive working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.
High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership.
Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organisation’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honourable dealings.

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact nick.newell@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Analyze integrated and extensive datasets to extract value, which directly impacts and influences business decisions. Work collaboratively with key business stakeholders to identify areas of value, develop solutions, and deliver insights to reduce overall cost of care for members and improve their clinical outcomes.

Key Details:
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Data Analyst

. This is a full-time onsite position. The Data Analyst shall support the maintenance of data holdings, ensure compliance to data standards, and perform quantitative analysis of data. jobs.description:
About The Team

Sobre a Shô

Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor.

Fazer parte do nosso time é a oportunidade de se desenvolver dentro de uma cultura de muita agilidade. Se você ama assumir grandes responsabilidades e fazer o que nunca foi feito, a Shô é seu lugar. Aqui você terá grandes desafios, trabalhará em colaboração com um time diverso e contribuirá para o futuro do e-commerce no Brasil, criamos impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos um modelo de trabalho híbrido para posições administrativas alocadas nos nossos escritórios.

Job Description

Qual será a sua missão

Você será responsável por garantir a competitividade de preço dos nossos produtos, atuando como ponte entre dados e negócio. Seu papel será analisar quais itens e deals devem ser priorizados, construir as listas de negociação junto ao cluster comercial e definir a melhor alocação de investimentos via rebate para os itens que precisam de ajuste de preço. Em resumo: você vai usar dados para tomar decisões que impactam diretamente vendas e competitividade no marketplace.

Como será seu dia a dia

Analisar dados de competitividade e performance de itens para identificar oportunidades de ajuste de preço

Construir e priorizar listas de itens para negociação com o cluster comercial

Receber o retorno das negociações e definir onde alocar budget de rebate nos itens que não tiveram sucesso na negociação direta

Realizar cálculos de eficiência para maximizar vendas com o menor investimento possível

Interagir diretamente com o cluster e com as áreas de negócio (BD plan), alinhando estratégia e execução

Extrair e consolidar dados via SQL no Data Switch, organizar e exportar para Sheets

Acompanhar KPIs de pricing e competitividade, gerando reports e análises para a liderança

Requirements

O que você precisa para assumir esse desafio:

Graduação completa
SQL proficiente (joins, CTEs, otimização de queries, criação de tabelas)
Experiência com extração e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados
Boa comunicação e capacidade de interlocução com áreas de negócio — você não vai só analisar, vai precisar conversar, argumentar e alinhar com diferentes stakeholders
Inglês intermediário
Experiência com análise de dados aplicada a pricing, competitividade ou planejamento comercial

Diferenciais

Vivência em e-commerce ou marketplace
Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Sheets avançado, dashboards)
Conhecimento de dinâmicas de precificação e negociação comercial

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

Who We're Looking For

Some programs at Rover don't belong to any one team. They pull in product, engineering, data, operations, and the business all at once, and they're the ones that matter most: the platform bet that changes how three orgs build, the flagship feature that can't ship until four teams build against the same plan, the problem everyone agrees is important and nobody can quite scope.

Those programs need someone who owns them outright. You'll join Rover's Technical Program Management team, a small and growing function that sits at the center of how engineering delivers complex, cross-functional work. TPMs here own how programs get executed, drive alignment across organizational boundaries, and bring structured thinking to the hardest problems on the roadmap, all in service of better experiences for the pet parents and sitters who depend on our platform every day.

Your scope is defined by difficulty rather than by domain. Programs land with you because of their complexity, ambiguity, and visibility, not because of which part of the product they touch. You'll go deep enough in each domain to be genuinely useful, then do it again somewhere else.

Problems arrive without shape, and your first job is to give them one: a problem statement the room can commit to, a scope with an explicit boundary, named owners and decision rights, and a definition of success set before the build starts. Your second is the technical judgment to be a true peer to engineering: reading a dependency chain, evaluating trade-offs without needing full translation, knowing when to slow down and build the durable thing versus speed up and take on debt deliberately, and spotting where we're walking through a one-way door. You won't just run a playbook. You'll help write it, turning each program into repeatable patterns that make the next one sharper.

Most of it comes down to judgment. The role is a steady run of calls with no obviously right answer: when to force a decision and when to let a team keep exploring, when to escalate and when escalating costs more than the delay it saves, when good enough now beats correct later. What matters isn't whether you follow a process, it's whether those instincts are calibrated and you can explain them afterward.

That extends to how you use AI. We're looking for someone who's gone past automating the obvious, like status reports and risk tracking, and is thinking about where these tools change the work more fundamentally: untangling dependencies across a messy program, catching risk earlier in the signal, opening up new ways for distributed teams to collaborate. What matters isn't how many tools you've tried. It's your point of view on where they create real leverage.

This is a role for someone who moves easily across teams and domains, and brings order to complexity without adding bureaucracy.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Downtown Seattle Office two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in the Greater Seattle Area or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities

Take programs from shapeless to executable: converge stakeholders on what problem is actually being solved, set the scope and what's explicitly out of it, establish who owns which decisions, and define what success will be measured by
Own the execution strategy from there: turning competing priorities into a coherent plan with owners and sequencing, and making the calls that determine how the work comes together across Rover
Drive decisions rather than track them. Frame the trade-off, make a recommendation, get the right people in the room, and identify the decision maker when the path forward isn't obvious, then land the decision and hold it
Be the point of alignment across organizational boundaries: keep priorities cohesive, surface where they conflict, and get teams to a shared path forward without waiting for an escalation to force it
Be a true peer to engineering on the technical dimension of the program, covering architecture implications, dependency chains, data integrity, and rollout and cutover planning. Pressure-test timelines and sequencing before they slip
Define and report the KPIs that tell teams whether a program is healthy, so risk surfaces early and progress is easy to communicate with confidence
Be the source of truth for program health. Build and maintain the artifacts that keep a program legible — charters, plans, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs — and communicate crisply in both registers: the detail engineering needs and the summary a leadership audience can act on
Own launch and delivery readiness, making sure everyone from engineering leads to executive sponsors has what they need to move forward. Treat launch as a checkpoint rather than a finish line: the measurement that tells us whether the program delivered should outlast go-live
Push AI tools further in how programs run: automating the reporting and tracking that doesn't need a human, and building the workflows and frameworks that help teams across the program move faster
Ramp fast in unfamiliar domains: build the working relationships, learn enough of the system to ask the right questions, and earn credibility quickly when the teams are new to you
Be the connective tissue across our Seattle and Barcelona teams, and contribute to Rover's TPM practice so each program runs better than the last

Your Qualifications:

8+ years driving complex, cross-functional technical programs, ideally at a marketplace, consumer tech, or SaaS company
A track record of owning high-complexity, ambiguous programs end to end across multiple domains and stakeholder groups, not a single specialty. You've taken programs from scoping and strategy through delivery and retrospective in domains you didn't start out knowing, including ones where your first deliverable was a scope that didn't exist before you got there
A way of working through ambiguous situations rather than a tolerance for them: orienting quickly on incomplete or conflicting information, separating what's genuinely unknown from what simply hasn't been asked, and breaking a shapeless problem into parts people can start on before the full picture exists
High agency in driving decisions rather than documenting them, and stellar stakeholder alignment across organizational lines, including with senior leadership. You can hold a room of partners with competing incentives, know when to make the recommendation yourself and when to find the person who owns the call, and leave with a shared plan
Judgment under uncertainty, and the ability to explain it: when to force a decision and when to wait, when to escalate and when to absorb the risk yourself, when to hold the line on scope and when to let it move. You can point to calls you got right and calls you'd make differently now
The technical acumen to be a true peer to engineering: reading a dependency chain, evaluating trade-offs without needing full translation, debating technical approaches, and finding where the real sequencing risk lives, where architectural patterns need to evolve, or where we're choosing one-way doors
Strong core program management craft: standing up a plan and a status process, running a decision-making cadence, using metrics to surface risk early, show progress, and tell whether a program delivered after it shipped, and identifying what's missing in planning and execution before it costs the program. You're as comfortable speaking technically as non-technically, and can bridge between the two
A habit of pushing AI tools further in your work: automating repetitive tasks like status reporting or risk tracking, building custom workflows, or creating frameworks that help teams move faster
You won't check every box on this list, and that's okay. If most of it sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you

Nice to Have:

Depth in more than one technical domain, for example platform and infrastructure alongside consumer product, payments, or data
Experience running programs across a globally distributed organization, where the teams you depend on sit in different time zones and decisions can't wait for everyone to be awake

Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

new_jobs.description:
WHY DONUT STUDIOS?

At New Engen, we help brands grow, not just bigger, but smarter. We’re a digital marketing agency that drives meaningful impact across the entire customer journey by integrating media, creative, analytics, influencer, and retail strategies into performance-driven campaigns.

Donut Studios is our in-house creative studio, purpose-built to craft high-performing, platform-native, and digital content for the world’s most ambitious brands. As a key part of New Engen’s suite of specialized solutions, alongside offerings like the Acorn Creator Suite — Donut Studios helps unlock breakthrough creative that drives results, fast.

We’re a collaborative group of strategists, content creators, copywriters, editors, designers, account strategists, and more who are all in on helping brands, and each other, thrive. We work hard, stay humble, and build with purpose.

What You'll Do

Keep Projects Moving

Manage day-to-day project timelines, task tracking, and creative workflows using Workfront, Asana, and Notion ensuring deliverables stay on schedule from brief through final delivery.

Run an Agile Operating Cadence

AWS operates on an agile model — daily standups and other agile ceremonies are a standing expectation. You'll run or participate in sprint ceremonies, manage backlogs, and adapt scope in short, iterative cycles depending on your workstream (e.g., two-day turnarounds for embedded/quick-turn work, two-week sprints for always-on support).

Drive Clear, Two-Way Communication

Own the cadence of project updates and delivery forecasts. This role requires both strong client-facing communication (representing the engagement professionally to AWS stakeholders, under the New Engen brand) and strong internal communication (keeping creative, strategy, and cross-functional teammates aligned on priorities, timelines, and next steps).

Support Creative & Event Delivery

Coordinate creative assignments across the full project lifecycle. Depending on workstream, this may include coordinating global event delivery across time zones (GMT, EST, APJ), managing tight SLAs and late-breaking content, or supporting on-site production logistics (e.g., re:Invent).

Own Budget & Reporting

Monitor pod budget and monthly burn-rate reporting; track scope and spend through the PO → IDP → campaign → work-order structure, flagging when net-new work requires an amended work order.

Stay One Step Ahead

Maintain accurate project trackers, monitor timelines, identify potential risks early, and proactively communicate issues before they impact delivery. Own escalation handling for your pod.

Collaborate Across Teams

Partner with creatives, strategists, and clients to keep everyone aligned on project status, expectations, deliverables, and priorities across a large, cross-functional team.

Embrace Smarter Ways of Working

Support the implementation of AI-powered workflows, automation, and operational improvements that help teams work more efficiently.

Solve Problems Every Day

Remove day-to-day project roadblocks, escalate larger issues when needed, and help keep momentum across multiple deliverables and deadlines.

Grow Your Craft

Work closely with the Senior/Director PM to strengthen your project management skills, complete AWS-specific onboarding (badging, Workfront training), and continue building your operational expertise.

What You Bring

7+ years of project management or project coordination experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, or fast-paced client services environment.
Agile project management experience required — hands-on familiarity with Scrum/Kanban ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, backlog management) and comfort operating in short, iterative cycles.
Strong client and internal communication skills — able to represent the engagement professionally to enterprise client stakeholders, while also keeping internal cross-functional teams clearly informed and aligned.
Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
Proficiency with Workfront, Asana, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace (or similar tools); willingness to learn client-specific systems.
Comfort with budget tracking/reporting (burn rate, work orders) and managing escalations under pressure.
Ability to coordinate across time zones for global/event-based work, as needed by workstream.
Familiarity with AI-powered tools and a willingness to embrace new technologies.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to identify issues early.
Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred but not required.

Perks & Benefits

Remote or hybrid work environment with flexible hours
Unlimited PTO + company holidays
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability coverage
Life & AD&D insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave & family support
Pet care perks & insurance
Learning & career development programs
Commuter & transit benefits
Exclusive employee discounts

Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000 annually

Compensation for each opportunity is determined based on the applicable labor market, the scope and structure of the role or engagement, and the individual’s qualifications and experience.

New Engen is proud to have offices in Seattle, New York, and Northwest Arkansas, each one anchoring teams that drive creativity, collaboration, and culture. But great work isn’t limited to those zip codes. We also support a distributed team of remote employees across the country, giving people the flexibility to do their best work wherever they are.

We currently hire full-time employees in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin

Let’s Build What’s Next Together — If you’re passionate about media and eager to make a meaningful impact with a team that’s all in, we’d love to hear from you.

Important Notice About Job Openings

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These attempts are often designed to steal your personal information or trick you into paying fees for recruitment or training services.

New Engen does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fees at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process.

All legitimate job openings will be posted directly on our careers page. Communication about these roles will come exclusively from New Engen Recruitment through our ATS, Greenhouse. We will never conduct recruiting outreach through unsolicited text messages or from the @newengen.online domain.

If you have any concerns about the authenticity of any message claiming to be from New Engen, please contact us immediately at peopleteam@newengen.com before taking any further action.

We take your security seriously and are here to support you, ensuring your job search is a safe, positive experience.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Supply Chain Project Manager at Hyper Solutions leads cross-functional supply chain initiatives from concept through execution, ensuring projects related to sourcing, supplier performance, inventory optimization, ERP enhancements, logistics, and operational scalability are delivered on time and aligned with the company’s growth strategy.

This role serves as a critical bridge between Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and external suppliers—driving structure, accountability, and visibility across complex manufacturing and infrastructure programs. The ideal candidate brings strong project leadership, deep supply chain acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset to help build scalable systems that support Hyper’s rapid growth.

Core Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end supply chain projects including supplier onboarding, capacity expansion, inventory strategy, logistics optimization, ERP enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.
Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and budgets.
Drive project governance, status reporting, escalation, and stakeholder communication.
Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management on new supplier introductions, contract implementations, and on-time delivery improvement initiatives.
Coordinate with domestic and international suppliers on production readiness, lead times, and capacity planning.
Serve as project lead for NetSuite-related supply chain initiatives, including workflow enhancements, inventory and demand planning improvements, and KPI standardization.
Align cross-functional execution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, Logistics, and Field Services.
Establish and track performance metrics (OTD, inventory turns, days on hand, supplier performance).

Additional Responsibilities

Support mitigation planning for supply risk, shortages, and quality issues.
Develop SOPs, playbooks, and project templates to improve repeatability and scalability.
Facilitate project reviews, decision forums, and post-implementation retrospectives.
Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned and process standardization.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing project management.
Proven success leading cross-functional projects in fast-growing or complex environments.
Strong understanding of procurement, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and manufacturing or infrastructure supply chains.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred).
Proficiency with project management tools (Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in electrical infrastructure, data center, industrial manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environments.
Familiarity with supplier contracts, MSAs, and performance metrics.
Experience supporting international suppliers and global logistics.
PMP, CPIM, CSCP, or similar certification a plus.

Why Hyper?

At Hyper, you won’t just manage projects, you’ll help build the systems and processes that enable a rapidly scaling organization to deliver mission-critical power and infrastructure solutions. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and suppliers, gaining broad exposure across the full supply chain while playing a visible role in driving execution, efficiency, and operational excellence.

In addition to competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) with company match, Hyper offers clear opportunities for professional growth and development as the company continues to scale.

Location

Onsite in Richmond, VA, or remote depending on candidate location and business needs.

Compensation

The anticipated minimum starting salary range for this role is $105,000 - $135,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications and location. This hire will be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

Hyper Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.

All applications will be used exclusively for selection purposes and handled confidentially by authorized personnel only. Your application may also be considered for other suitable positions within Hyper Solutions, Inc.

Please note that Hyper Solutions is currently unable to offer visa sponsorship, and applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

new_jobs.description:
Remote / Home-Based | UK-wide travel

Company Car + Benefits

Permanent | Full-time

Noble Green Energy is growing — and we’re looking for an experienced Solar PV Project Manager to take ownership of the delivery of our commercial and industrial solar projects across the UK.

This is a genuine delivery role. You’ll take an issued design package and turn it into a completed, operational installation — owning the programme, subcontractors, live site delivery and client relationship from mobilisation through to handover.

We have a significantly increasing volume of commercial installations coming through, alongside a growing pipeline of larger 1 MW–20 MWp projects, so this is an opportunity to join a business where your experience will have real impact from day one.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

🔹 Building and owning project programmes and Gantt charts using MS Project, Asta Powerproject, Primavera or similar

🔹 Managing multiple live C&I solar installations simultaneously

🔹 Planning and sequencing works from design handover through procurement, installation, commissioning and handover

🔹 Managing electrical, roofing, scaffolding, steelwork, craneage and specialist subcontractors

🔹 Holding contractors accountable for programme, quality and safety

🔹 Mobilising sites, coordinating trades and managing day-to-day delivery

🔹 Reviewing RAMS, carrying out safety audits and fulfilling relevant CDM 2015 responsibilities

🔹 Inspecting installations against design, specification and BS 7671 requirements

🔹 Managing snagging, commissioning, testing and final handover

🔹 Acting as the main client contact throughout construction

🔹 Chairing progress meetings and providing clear reporting to senior stakeholders

🔹 Managing variations and keeping projects commercially and operationally on track

What We’re Looking For

You’ll need at least 3 years’ hands-on experience managing commercial and industrial solar PV installations
— managing the build and delivery rather than supporting someone else who does.

You Should Also Have

✅ Proven experience creating and managing your own project programmes

✅ Strong subcontractor management experience

✅ SMSTS or SSSTS

✅ Valid CSCS or ECS card

✅ Good understanding of electrical drawings, single line diagrams and BS 7671

✅ Confidence dealing with senior client stakeholders

✅ Experience managing multiple live sites

✅ Strong organisation and documentation skills

✅ Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel nationwide

✅ Existing right to work in the UK — no sponsorship available

Desirable Experience

It would be great if you also have:

18th Edition / C&G 2382
Inspection & Testing / C&G 2391
NEBOSH or IOSH
APM PMQ, PRINCE2 or equivalent
Ground-mount and larger-scale solar projects (1 MW+)
Battery energy storage integrated with PV
MCS experience
DNO process knowledge (G98/G99/G100)
Solar PV O&M experience

Importantly, this is not a design position.

You won't be expected to produce PV designs, use PVsyst/AutoCAD/OpenSolar/Helioscope/PV*SOL, or originate grid connections. Those responsibilities sit with our Technical Manager.

We're looking for someone who is decisive on site, highly organised, technically credible and straightforward with clients and contractors — someone who takes ownership and gets projects delivered properly, safely and on time.

Competitive basic salary, depending on experience (£50,000 - £60,000)
Bonus
Company car
25 days’ holiday + bank holidays
Company pension
Perkbox benefits
Remote / home-based working
Nationwide travel with expenses covered

You'll scope briefs, plan resource, schedule production, and keep design and performance workstreams moving — owning the creative roadmap, flagging risk early, and protecting both quality and timelines. This is a hybrid role (3 days a week onsite) based in our London office and reports to the Senior Creative Project Manager.

You Will:

Own intake and triage of creative briefs across digital design, programmatic, and performance marketing — agreeing scope, timelines, and success criteria before work begins.
Build and maintain workback schedules and campaign roadmaps, sequencing design and performance workstreams to hit launch dates across all active EMEA & APAC markets.
Allocate designers, copywriters, and freelance/agency support against demand; forecast capacity and flag constraints before they become delivery risks.
Track assets end-to-end — brief, design, review, legal approval, localisation, and trafficking — in project management tooling (e.g. ClickUp), confirming specs, CTAs, UTMs, and platform requirements before anything goes live.
Coordinate delivery of performance marketing assets across paid social, paid search, display, and programmatic.
Act as the single point of contact between creative, performance marketing, and regional stakeholders for all in-flight projects, communicating dates, dependencies, and blockers proactively.
Partner with creative leads, designers, and copywriters to translate business requirements into actionable, well-scoped briefs, and with growth marketing to align production with campaign flighting and media plans.
Coordinate with EMEA and APAC stakeholders on local requirements, approvals, and compliance needs.
Manage external agencies and vendors — sharing assets, confirming timelines, and running review cycles — and own the UGC workstream and agency relationship.
Maintain live status trackers, accurate documentation, and version control across all live projects.
Own the test-and-learn agenda: run retrospectives, capture learnings, and make sure they shape future briefs and creative development.
Resolve scheduling conflicts, resourcing gaps, and shifting priorities with structured thinking, escalating when trade-offs need leadership input.
Identify and bring in better workflow tools, templates, and processes that reduce rework — especially AI-assisted ones.

You Have:

3-5+ years proven experience managing marketing production workflows, ideally spanning both digital design and performance marketing.
Strong proficiency with project management tools (ClickUp or similar) and familiarity with creative production processes.
Working knowledge of performance marketing channels (paid social, paid search, display, programmatic, landing pages, ASO) and their creative and technical requirements.
Comfort working across Adobe Creative Suite / Figma files at a production level — specs, exports, versioning — even without design authorship.
Experience working with global or multi-market teams and external agencies.
Exceptional organisation: you run multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders without dropping details.
Reliability and accountability: you own projects fully from intake to delivery and surface blockers early.
A proactive, self-directed approach — you spot risks and opportunities without being asked.
A collaborative style that works across designers, copywriters, performance marketers, and regional stakeholders.
High standards and a strong eye for detail.

Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum).
Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated, multi-market consumer brand.
Additional European or Asian language skills relevant to EMEA & APAC markets.
Familiarity with AI-assisted creative production or workflow tools.

This is a remote position that can be located anywhere in the US.

Position Purpose

Drive strategic healthcare transformation initiatives across health plan operations by identifying opportunities to improve clinical and operational performance, enhance member outcomes and experience, reduce healthcare costs, and support regulatory and contractual requirements.

Lead multiple concurrent initiatives from opportunity identification and business case development through implementation and performance measurement. Partner closely with clinical operations, Medical Economics, Finance, IT, Product, Provider/Network teams, Payment Integrity, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate healthcare data and operational needs into actionable strategies and measurable results.

This role requires an understanding of the healthcare payer environment, including managed care and Medicaid, and the ability to independently lead complex initiatives that span clinical, operational, financial, and technical functions.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve healthcare quality, clinical and operational efficiency, member outcomes, service levels, regulatory compliance, and medical cost performance.
Lead strategic initiatives across health plan functions, including areas such as Utilization Management, Care Management, Behavioral Health, LTSS, Clinical Operations, and other payer operations.
Partner with Medical Economics, Finance, Analytics, and business leaders to understand healthcare utilization and cost trends, identify key drivers and addressable opportunities, develop business cases, and establish appropriate performance measures.
Interpret healthcare data and operational findings to help translate identified opportunities into actionable strategies, project plans, and measurable interventions.
Develop strategies to realize improvement and cost-saving opportunities and facilitate organizational prioritization, leadership alignment, and resource allocation.
Manage multiple complex projects and initiatives through the full project lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, business case development, planning, implementation, measurement, and transition to operational ownership.
Establish project objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, decision points, and performance measures and maintain appropriate project governance and documentation.
Lead cross-functional workgroups involving clinical, operational, financial, analytical, technical, and executive stakeholders to drive decisions and deliver defined outcomes.
Partner with IT, Product, and operational teams to translate business and clinical requirements into technology-enabled solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.
Monitor initiative performance following implementation, partnering with business owners and Medical Economics/Analytics to evaluate outcomes, validate realized impact, and identify opportunities for continued improvement.
Provide clear and concise communication of project status, risks, financial opportunities, decisions, and performance to senior and executive leadership through presentations, dashboards, and executive summaries.
Navigate competing priorities and negotiate with stakeholders to secure resources, resolve issues, mitigate risks, and maintain progress toward strategic objectives.
Maintain working knowledge of managed care operations, healthcare industry trends, regulatory requirements, and Medicaid program considerations relevant to assigned initiatives.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Master’s degree preferred.
5+ years project implementation, product or program management experience.
Experience within a healthcare payer or managed care organization strongly preferred, with knowledge of Medicaid and/or other government-sponsored health programs preferred.
Demonstrated understanding of healthcare payer operations and the relationship between clinical operations, healthcare utilization, medical cost, quality, regulatory requirements, and financial performance preferred.
Experience partnering with Medical Economics, healthcare analytics, Finance, or similar functions to evaluate utilization and cost trends, develop business cases, establish performance measures, and assess initiative outcomes preferred.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional healthcare initiatives involving clinical, operational, financial, analytical, and/or technology stakeholders preferred.
Strong executive communication, facilitation, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to independently drive initiatives from an identified opportunity through implementation and measurement preferred.
Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) and/or healthcare-related credentials preferred but not required.

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

Experience in business processes design or automation tools development.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

As a Staff Technical Program Manager (Release Management), you will report to the Manager of Release Management and join our Software Product-Design team. This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role that balances strategic release architecture and automation with hands-on, day-to-day release train execution. We are hiring for this role to help drive scale and automation in our release operations for predictive prevention, establishing robust automated release gating as our commercial driverless fleet scales from a dozen vehicles to thousands. This is a high-impact opportunity for a force multiplier who thrives on combining hands-on tactical execution with long-term operational scale. You are highly motivated to remove manual friction, manage release operations, and automate software release and deployment frameworks in a safety-critical, high-velocity environment.

In this role you will

Lead Day-to-Day Release Operations & Cadence: Own and execute the end-to-end release cycle, including orchestrating regular release train schedules, managing branch cut-offs, running daily release/build triage, and coordinating hotfix deployments across software and vehicle platforms.
Cross-Functional Coordination & Release Communication: Serve as the primary operational hub for release readiness, driving daily alignment across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams while maintaining transparent release communications and dashboards.
Drive Predictive Prevention and Release Automation: Shift release operations toward predictive prevention by identifying and eliminating manual friction points, automating release workflows, and utilizing AI/ML tools for triage classification and anomaly detection.
Establish Data-Driven Release Gating: Help architect and maintain automated "Release Gates" that auto-assemble compliance evidence using structured data (Single Source of Truth), ensuring rigorous quality and safety standards before release promotion.
Manage High-Scale Branching & Change Control: Govern and orchestrate concurrent release branches across diverse customers, hardware configurations, and Operational Design Domains (ODDs), maintaining absolute branching hygiene and change control.
Ensure Safety-First Rigor and Auditable Compliance: Treat release documentation and launch reports with software-grade discipline—ensuring version control, complete auditability, and safety compliance without introducing operational bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications

7+ Years of Hands-On Release Experience: Technical program management, release engineering, or systems engineering background with direct, day-to-day release train execution and managing software-hardware integrations in complex environments.
Safety-Critical Domain Expertise: Experience working under strict safety-regulated standards (such as ISO 26262, DO-178C, or ISO 13485) within automotive, aerospace, medical or robotics, with strong configuration management, baseline, and change control practices.
Tactical Build & CI/CD Execution: Practical, hands-on technical experience with CI/CD build automation tools (e.g., Buildkite, GitHub Actions) and monorepo build systems (e.g., Bazel) to troubleshoot and execute daily release operations at scale.
Complex Branching & Daily Triage: Proven track record of orchestrating concurrent release branches, running hands-on daily build/release triage, and executing hotfix deployments across diverse teams and hardware platforms.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance: Collaborative track record of partnering across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams to establish transparent governance, shared release visibility, and cross-team trust.
Customer & Team Support Mindset: Strong team player willing to support internal operations, external partners, and high-priority releases with occasional evening or weekend coverage as needed.
Travel Requirement: Ability to travel to engineering centers in Mountain View, CA, Terminal Operations in Texas or Pittsburgh, PA as business needs arise.

Desirable Qualifications

AV & Robotics Background: Direct, hands-on experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, machine learning systems, or complex cyber-physical environments.
AI-Leveraged Release Operations: Practical experience applying ML/AI tooling to day-to-day release operations, such as automated test-failure classification, triage automation, or pipeline anomaly detection.
Automation-First & Collaborative Mindset: Passion for building self-service release tooling and reducing operational friction while fostering seamless cross-functional alignment and developer enablement.
Cloud & SaaS Infrastructure: Practical familiarity with cloud environments (AWS) and progressive deployment methodologies (feature flagging, progressive delivery, service dependency ordering).
Proactive Execution & Planning: Proven capability to manage day-to-day edge cases and unknown release risks by establishing team-wide visibility and proactive build health tracking.

For roles based in San Francisco, CA and Mountain View, CA: The salary range for this position is $181,000 - $290,000 per year.

For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA: The salary range for this position is $163,000 - $261,000 per year.

Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Global Services PMO

Location:

Italy (Bologna, Tognana)
